reason: I have strictly refused third-party cloud tools because client confidentiality is non-negotiable, and when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free without any data leak risk, I cannot justify paying ₹12,990 upfront. I would need to test the free pilot on dummy files first to verify that Google Drive access is strictly quarantined before spending a single rupee.
objection: Connecting any third-party software to our Google Drive creates an unacceptable risk of confidential PAN, ITR, and ROC filing records leaking, and our current free Excel workflow carries zero data risk.
would_change_my_mind: Verifiable in-app proof that Docketra cannot access files outside its dedicated folder, plus a smooth test on the free pilot that meaningfully speeds up my 10 PM ROC filing reviews without compromising client data.
